policy: Thirty public integer gray/RGB/RGBA cases at 8/10/12/16-bit source depth, including mixed 16-bit alpha and partial groups, in regular and progressive modes. Both independent complete normalized PNG grids must match the prior first-party implementation exactly, with no larger complete file. Native alpha tolerances are those of the pinned 16-bit PNG conversion; separate Float32 fixtures require exact native 8/16-bit alpha.
